Should the comparison be case-sensitive or case-insensitive when checking character equality?
Do whitespace characters and special characters count as part of the character comparison?
How should empty strings be handled - are two empty strings considered to have equal characters?
What is the expected behavior when one string is empty and the other is not?
Should the function consider the order of characters, or only their presence/frequency?
How should duplicate characters within each string be handled in the comparison?
What is the expected return type - should it return a boolean value or some other indicator?
